title: TEMPLATE
medium: the starting point for a new piece: canvas lib (core, live, ink, rig, recursion) + a three-mode main
summary: Copy this folder to start a piece. An 8-bar loop that exercises the lib: a hand-lettered title writing itself on, a figure seated on a chair built from its body (contacts logged, ?qa=1 draws them), a bulb that pops on each snare and a nod on each kick from the song's MIDI events, a planted-feet walk on the beat, and three endings as variants: a vector droste into the window that turns on the chord change (the default), the lamp going out, or the walker leaving the empty chair. Each loops back to the title.

ending.note: bar 7. droste: the view falls through the window, turning a step on each chord change; lamp: the lamp goes out, the room sinks into ink from the lamp outward, and the camera pushes into the paper-white window; exit: he walks out, the camera pushes in on the empty chair while the paper fades in, then it un-draws itself. Each ends on blank paper, the title card's first frame.

gallery.alt: A plain ink line drawing on cream paper: a figure at a café table under a hanging lamp. A hand-lettered title writes itself on; the figure sits, nodding on the kick as the lamp's bulb pops on the snare, then walks past the empty chair and away, and the view falls through the tilting window back to the title.
